encoder_method_note:
The skyline is made of 16 building rectangles whose heights encode the letters: each height is the letter's alphabet position (a=1 … z=26) multiplied by 10 pixels, so 120 = l, 50 = e, 200 = t, 180 = r, 10 = a, and so on. The buildings are split into five clusters separated by wider street gaps (and wrapped in separate groups), with each cluster being one word, giving "le / train / part / a / midi". All other elements (sky, moon, stars, ground, window pattern) are purely decorative.
